name: @avatark/membership
description: Shared membership plan-tier vocabulary (Free today; Paid/Enterprise/Education as future targets). Distinct from @avatark/account's MembershipSummary/ProductRelationship, which are that package's own UI-adapter shapes -- this is the underlying plan concept AvatarK owns. No billing implementation.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
